description:
With the fixed TPC-DS binaries supporting stdout output via -FILTER Y,
update BenchBox data generation modules to leverage streaming output
for direct compression and open table format writing.

NOTE: The streaming infrastructure already existed in benchbox/core/tpcds/generator/streaming.py
but was broken because it used the old "-_filter y" flag which didn't work with unfixed dsdgen.
This TODO was reduced to updating the flag to use "-FILTER Y" (the fixed version).
